Messages.Author: Xto 3:16
Messages.Body:
The question is:

I have a vampire fo another player under my control with temptation,
buy another vampire that i'm controlling plays Banishment to this
vampire with temptation.

The vampire with temptation goes to my uncontrolled region or the
uncontrolled region of the first vampire's controler ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Xto 3:16 wrote:
> The question is:
>

> I have a vampire [of] another player under my control with temptation,
> [but] another vampire that i'm controlling plays Banishment to this

> vampire with temptation.
>
> The vampire with temptation goes to my uncontrolled region or the
> uncontrolled region of the first vampire's controler ?

The vampire's previous controller (that is, to the vampire's permanent
controller). Banishment breaks all temporary control effects (card text).
